description: Finds Harmonized System (HS) codes from UN Comtrade's HS reference list by code prefix or description keyword: code, official description, hierarchy level. It lists candidate headings and subheadings; it does not decide the legal tariff code for a shipment. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

q.description: HS code digits (e.g. 8703) or a keyword (e.g. motor cars)
